groups.id: branding is captured projection not personal identity
groups.comparison: ShopName deliberately public raw strings/Serde; for_operator derives proprietor from actual RenderedPersonalName and trade from BuildingUse. for_establishment explicitly consumes already-authoritative brand but checks trade matches shop_trade; emblem derived from same usage, mount/finish stable establishment streams. Immutable ECS component is replaced with scene input, not a new personal name authority. Public literal does not itself promise operator membership or known font repertoire. Closed emblem covers only smith/bake/weave, None legitimate for other public trades. Private pictogram line segments are fixed nonzero authored endpoints and polygons nonempty; no zero modulus executes for empty loop.

for_plan finds current exterior ground door/gate and its actual host wall, or current workplace passage and south wall; derives panel from same storey clearance. width1.35, height=min(available,.62), reject<.28. Mounting::find selects same current structural cuboid ID/actual axis-aligned face, full plate margin within tangent and vertical extent, bounded recess and hanger height. is_supported resolves retained support ID in current plan and checks whole plate contact, not centre-only. Raw SignSite/SignMounting public Serde fields are not sealed accepted assemblies; wall, contact, direction, panel and support could be independently replaced, no normal editor/factory bad case established.

groups.id: board and bracket derive same site
groups.comparison: Board wall/projecting orientation, centre, panel size all derive from the supplied site; bracket uses same mounting contact/top/board/hanger and same origin subtraction. Physical supports checks panel AABB against actual current solids and pedestrian minimum, intentionally permits mounting plate touching host. Site selection does not claim arbitrary rotation/scale/raw nonfinite admission. All original site fixtures and two-mount bounds read without execution.

SignPaintKey stores full brand/font/finish/emblem and quantized texture height, backing keyed by finish, iron shared. Fixed1024width means ordinary output content depends on those inputs and derived image height; instance world origin/physical scale belongs to transform, not material key. Height-key expression divides before multiply while painter multiplies before divide; no exact normal rounding-collision witness established, so no unqualified bit-identical promise. Cache clears handles when new key crosses64, allowing live users to retain shared assets. Actual client supplies one Bevy Assets resource set, no arbitrary cross-arena handle claim. Distant Board returns None before painting and lettering side count guards unwrap. Original renderer fixture fully read.

F059 records positive finite size exceeding native u32 byte-count capacity before allocation. For supported factory dimensions, paint allocates one width*height*4 buffer, writes alpha and same bounded pixel offsets, then returns those dimensions and bytes together. Text splits into one or two lines and clamps scale by actual measured ink bounds; empty/no-outline raw strings and unsupported bundled glyphs remain explicit public input/foreign-font preconditions, no whole font parser credit or invented runtime missing glyph. Public SignTexture fields themselves are a mutable DTO, not accepted GPU image token.

groups.id: current presentation mount and lettering lifecycle
groups.comparison: Actual presentation sites recomputes one factory site then filters each mount by supports. Spawn clones captured authored sign and chooses matching compiled mount or first supported fallback, updating sign.mount before board/PresentedSign retention. Lettering state stores child option and same sign/site/origin; any active camera inside48 loads, none or beyond60 unloads. Threshold hysteresis intentionally differs from35..45visibility fade. Existing retained sign fields are crate-visible, so arbitrary one-sided later mutation is not auto-synchronized, but normal scene replacement contract and actual normal mutation not proven here. Plugin resource/schedule declarations are not called-body coverage.
